request: Authenticated directory creation with create permission must run the configured after-upload hook when command execution is enabled. If the hook command cannot be found, the request must report an internal server error while leaving the created directory present in the user scope.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: fix(http): run upload hooks for directories (#6034)

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > http/resource_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestResourcePostRunsUploadHooksForDirectories)$' ./http >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
